title: Object Storage: outage review — Enterprise Support eligibility
content:
For Object Storage outage review, read portfolio discount fraction from the tier of the active support contract with the same customer and legal billing entity; use zero when no such contract exists.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage review in this situation? Read portfolio discount fraction from the tier of the active support contract with the same customer and legal billing entity; use zero when no such contract exists.
